TABLE.NAME: local_edguidance
TABLE.COMMENT: One block of teacher guidance, embedded in rich text by an opaque token. The text lives here rather than in the host HTML so that nothing reaches students by a path that skips the filter - search indexing, raw web service text, or a teacher switching the filter off.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course. Also how a draft is found when its activity is saved.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module whose text carries the token. 0 for a section's block, and for a draft, made while the activity was still being added and had no id.

FIELD.NAME: sectionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course section whose summary carries the token, with cmid 0. 0 for an activity's block or a draft.

FIELD.NAME: embedkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Random hex matching the token's data-edguidance attribute. Unique per activity, and per course among sections and drafts. Carried through backup and restore unchanged, except where a restored section's key is already taken in its course.

FIELD.NAME: introorder
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 if the token is not in the activity description (a chapter or page block). n if it is the nth token there. Recorded when the activity is saved, so the course page can find description guidance without reading every module's intro.

FIELD.NAME: presetslot
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 for guidance with its own text. 1..10 for guidance that uses that site preset, which is read live on every render. Not remapped by restore: it names a site setting, not something in the course.

FIELD.NAME: guidance
FIELD.COMMENT: The block's own text. For a block using a preset, a snapshot taken when it was linked, shown only if the preset slot is later emptied.
